voice.summary: VIRALMEDIA speaks like a sleek creative director who knows the work shows itself. It is brisk and slightly theatrical, with an italic flourish on one word and no filler.
dos: Lead with the result: speed, beauty, performance
Use one italic flourish per headline
Keep calls to action to two words
donts: Do not describe AI as 'magic' beyond the headline
Do not use more than one exclamation mark
Do not name tools or frameworks in the copy

taglines: Websites crafted for beauty and speed
Fast to launch, made to last
Design that goes viral on its own
From brief to live in days
boilerplate: VIRALMEDIA is an AI-powered web design agency that builds fast, beautiful websites built for lasting performance.
